page.notes: Long s is read as plain s throughout. "fervituros" is printed with a long-s form and is transcribed as "servituros"; "sincerum" follows the printed form and may be "sincerae" in the source. "mandantis" is printed as is and may be a misprint for "mandantibus". The word "tum" at the foot is a catchword. The small mark at the right margin by the last lines is an ornament and is not transcribed. The left strip is show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.
